🪢 Rakhi + GST = A Surprisingly Interesting Tax Question!

“Rakhi par GST lagta hai?” 🤔

The answer isn’t simply YES or NO!

It depends on the nature, constituent material and classification of the Rakhi. 👇

🟢 Traditional Kalava / Raksha Sutra
➡️ Treated as puja samagri → Nil GST

🟡 Gold / Silver Rakhi
➡️ Where classified as precious-metal/jewellery articles → GST applicable as per the relevant Chapter 71 classification

🟠 Other Material Rakhis
➡️ GST treatment depends on their constituent material and applicable classification. Certain Rakhis other than those made of Chapter 71 goods are specifically Nil-rated.

💡 The real GST lesson:
Two products may both be called “Rakhi”, but their GST treatment depends on their classification and constituent material.

👇 What do you think?

Should Rakhis be GST-free irrespective of material, or should GST treatment depend on their classification?

Comment your view — YES / NO + WHY 👇

🔄 Repost this if you think this is a useful GST concept for business owners & professionals.
